scenes.title: 1880 Paris Consultation & 1995 100-Case Map: Jules Cotard Listening as 'Mademoiselle X' Gestures to an Empty-Shell Torso Outline

layout.description: Sunlit high-key 1880 Parisian neurological study with tall French windows, an oak consultation desk holding a brass medical stethoscope (confirming a steady rhythmic pulse!), Cotard's 1880 *Délire des négations* case ledger, and an anatomical silhouette chart where the patient traces an empty hollow interior despite intact vital signs.

positions.who: Jules Cotard (mannequin in 1880 dark wool physician coat and waistcoat)
positions.where: gently holding a brass stethoscope showing a steady normal pulse reading while listening with calm clinical attentiveness

positions.who: 'Mademoiselle X' mannequin (motionless upright porcelain figure in modest 1880 buttoned wool dress)
positions.where: sitting very still, placing one hand flat over her sternum and gesturing toward an empty-outline anatomical sketch to insist her interior feels completely hollow and absent

props.name: 1880 acoustic stethoscope & normal pulse chart vs 'Hollow Shell' silhouette card
props.period_detail: contrasts 100% intact physiological pulse against absent insular interoceptive feeling
props.physical_behavior: visualizes Factor 1 sensory-feeling disconnect with museum-clean clarity

props.name: Berrios & Luque 100-Case Subtype Chart ('86% Organ Negation | Type I Neurological vs Type II/Depressive')
props.period_detail: clean clinical typology plaque beside Cotard's ledger

actions.verb_sequence: checks the steady physiological pulse and offers a warm porcelain cup -> Patient shakes head slowly pointing to the hollow-outline anatomical card to explain she feels zero internal organs
documents *le délire des négations* as a distinct neurological-psychiatric syndrome

reactions.reaction: still, perplexed certainty born from total absence of internal visceral feeling
notes the paradox between intact speech/pulse and lost inner bodily presence

scenes.wardrobe: 1880 Parisian physician frock coat and waistcoat; modest high-collared 1880 wool dress.
scenes.recognition_hook: Her pulse beats steadily under the doctor's stethoscope and her speech is crystal-clear — yet silenced internal feeling convinces her mind she is an empty shell.

key_visual.description: an 1880 Parisian physician with a stethoscope and clinical ledger seated across an oak desk from a still patient gesturing to a hollow-outline torso chart

scenes.title: 2013 Liège & Exeter PET Scan: Waking Speech With Anesthesia-Level Self-Network Dimming
scenes.era: 2013, Coma Science Group neuroimaging suite (Laureys & Zeman)

layout.description: Bright modern PET imaging review room displaying side-by-side brain metabolic maps: Healthy Awake vs Graham (Cotard) vs Restored Follow-Up.

positions.where: pointing in astonishment to the dimmed frontoparietal Default Mode metabolic map of a man conversing calmly right beside them

props.name: 3-panel FDG-PET comparison chart (Healthy / Acute Cotard / Recovered)
props.period_detail: shows profound frontoparietal hypometabolism reversing after treatment

actions.verb_sequence: compare acute dimmed self-network map against bright restored recovery map

reactions.reaction: smiles gratefully seeing objective proof of what he lived through and overcame

scenes.wardrobe: Modern white coats and casual cardigan.
scenes.recognition_hook: He walked into the scanner room talking clearly — yet his self-awareness network burned as little energy as deep anesthesia, until treatment switched it back on!

scenes.title: The Capgras–Cotard See-Saw: One Unplugged Wire, Two Opposite Blames

layout.description: Bright teaching table with a balanced two-branch diagram branching from 'Missing Insular Warmth' left to 'External Blame -> Capgras' and right to 'Internal Blame -> Cotard'.

positions.where: tracing how identical autonomic flatness flips between 'They are replicas' and 'I am a hollow shell'

props.name: Two-Factor Attribution Branch Board
props.period_detail: unifies neurology's two strangest delusions under one clear mechanism

actions.verb_sequence: flips attribution arrow from outward (Capgras) to inward (Cotard)

reactions.reaction: nods as two mysterious syndromes snap into one clear framework

scenes.recognition_hook: Unplug the brain's emotional warmth wire: blame the outside world and you get Capgras; blame yourself and you get Cotard.

scenes.title: Reversible Medical Triggers & Full Recovery Back to Everyday Life
scenes.era: Modern hospital discharge & sunlit garden walk

layout.description: Sunlit hospital terrace where a physician reviews a cleared medication-metabolite chart as a recovered patient enjoys warm tea outdoors.

positions.where: celebrating full return of felt vitality after clearing neurotoxic medication / treating the root cause

props.name: cleared clinical recovery chart & warm porcelain teacup
props.period_detail: felt warmth of the teacup in the palms signals restored insular interoception

actions.verb_sequence: wraps hands around the warm teacup feeling real warmth and presence again

scenes.recognition_hook: What once looked like an untreatable Gothic mystery often reverses completely when modern neurology treats the underlying circuit or chemical trigger.
